title: IbuInput
description: Normalized input for IBU calculation tools. Decoupled from BeerJSON storage format: an adapter converts a BeerJSON Recipe + Equipment into this shape.

method.description: Bitterness estimation method. Enum aligned with BeerJSON IBUMethodType.

batch_size_l.description: Post-boil wort volume in liters (cooled, into fermenter).

og.description: Original gravity (specific gravity, e.g. 1.050). Used as the wort gravity proxy in utilization formulas.

post_boil_minutes_to_80c.description: Minutes from flameout until the wort drops below 80 °C. Hops keep isomerising while the wort cools; the calc follows an exponential cooling curve from 100 °C towards 20 °C that crosses 80 °C at this time. 0 = instant chill, which matches the Tinseth / Rager calibration. Typical: wort chiller 0-5, no-chill pot 30-60, no-chill cube 90-150.

name.description: Optional, for traceability and per-addition reporting.

alpha_acid_pct.description: Alpha acid content as a percentage (e.g. 5.5 means 5.5%).

time_min.description: Contact time at the addition's temperature, in minutes. For boil hops this is the standard boil time; for whirlpool / hopstand additions it's the hold time at `temperature_c` before chilling.

form.description: Hop form. Only 'leaf (wet)' changes the result: fresh, unkilned cones are ~80 % water, so their mass is scaled by 0.2 while `alpha_acid_pct` stays the variety's dry (kilned) value.

temperature_c.description: Optional contact temperature in °C. Omit (or set ≥ 100) for boiling-temp additions. Whirlpool / hopstand additions held below 100 °C use Malowicki isomerisation kinetics at this temperature, so cooler stands bitter less.
